The club

What we’re building

We’re students at Henry M. Gunn Senior High School building tools for the subjects we study. Our projects turn everyday study problems into something you can open and use.

Our collection includes chemistry practice, quote lookup, and vocabulary cards. We’re planning to expand into more subjects, including math and AP U.S. History.
